agyos_skill.intent: Use when requesting guidance on how to navigate, query, prompt, or apply the overall freelance skill repository, or when looking for end-to-end freelancer lifecycle case studies and lifestyle impact analysis.
agyos_skill.instructions: Navigate the agentic freelance skill repository, understand how to prompt your AI assistant, see a complete end-to-end freelance lifecycle in action, and discover how these systems transform your career and personal life. To utilize this meta-guide's principles, instructions, or lifecycle examples, read the corresponding document in the `references/` directory: | File | Focus | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | [09A-ECOSYSTEM-GUIDE.md](references/09A-ECOSYSTEM-GUIDE.md) | Skill Ecosystem & Prompting Guide | Navigating the 9 modules, trigger keywords, and prompting formulas for AI agents. | | [09B-END-TO-END-EXAMPLE.md](references/09B-END-TO-END-EXAMPLE.md) | End-to-End Lifecycle Walkthrough | Chronological case study of a project from branding to acquisition, closing, delivery, crisis, and upsell. | | [09C-FREELANCE-LIFE-IMPACT.md](references/09C-FREELANCE-LIFE-IMPACT.md) | Life & Career Impact Analysis | Shifting from chaos to agency-level systems, time-reclamation math, and emotional resilience. | When a user asks how to start or where to find resources: - Reference [09A-ECOSYSTEM-GUIDE.md](references/09A-ECOSYSTEM-GUIDE.md) to explain the 9-module system and map their current business challenge to the correct skill folder. - Provide them with the standard Agentic Trigger prompt to copy-paste. When a user asks for a realistic demonstration of how these skills work in practice: - Reference [09B-END-TO-END-EXAMPLE.md](references/09B-END-TO-END-EXAMPLE.md) to showcase the story of Aria, an AI/ML Freelancer. - Highlight the exact transition points: how client acquisition leads to sales closing, which triggers legal contracts, which flows into project kickoff, and how scope creep is defended using the emergency kit. When a user is overwhelmed, doubts their rates, or struggles with burnout: - Reference [09C-FREELANCE-LIFE-IMPACT.md](references/09C-FREELANCE-LIFE-IMPACT.md) to present the "Before vs. After" comparison. - Walk through the time savings breakdown showing how automating administration and templating development saves up to 15+ hours per week. - Discuss boundaries and financial runway planning as tools for emotional sanity. | Concept | File | Section | One-Line Summary | |---------|------|---------|------------------| | Prompting Formula | [09A](references/09A-ECOSYSTEM-GUIDE.md) | 2 | Context + Skill Reference + Input Data = Actionable Output | | Skill Matrix Mapping | [09A](references/09A-ECOSYSTEM-GUIDE.md) | 1 | Match business pain points directly to the correct skill namespace | | Aria's Case Study | [09B](references/09B-END-TO-END-EXAMPLE.md) | 1-6 | Six-phase narrative showing joint AI-Freelancer execution of all 8 skills | | Paradigm Shift | [09C](references/09C-FREELANCE-LIFE-IMPACT.md) | 1 | Transitioning from a reactive task-doer to a high-value systems-builder | | Time Reclamation Math | [09C](references/09C-FREELANCE-LIFE-IMPACT.md) | 2 | 15.5 hours saved weekly via client acquisition, operations, and developer templates | The following ready-to-run prompts are located in the reference files:
